name: search_library
description: Search the complete GPUI Box developer catalog: packages, public Rust symbols and methods, components, supporting types, themes/tokens, guides/recipes, scenes, and assets. Results are paginated and identify the exact catalog revision.

query.description: Words matched against names, docs, signatures, paths, and package identities. Empty lists the selected kinds.

kinds.description: Optional catalog kinds. All kinds are searched when omitted.

package.description: Optional exact package filter for Rust symbols

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page

name: library_item
description: Read one exact package, Rust symbol/method, component/type, theme, guide, recipe, scene, or asset from the generated developer index. Prefer an id returned by search_library; name plus kind is also accepted.

id.description: Stable result id, such as gpui::window::Window, component:Button, package:gpui-box, or guide:motion

name.description: Exact item name when id is unavailable

name: recipe
description: Return the most relevant verified GPUI Box implementation recipe or guide section for a development goal, including its exact guide source and related catalog revision.

goal.description: What you need to implement or verify

id.description: Optional exact recipe id returned by search_library

name: render_scene
description: Return a canonical scene PNG. Hosted MCP returns the immutable gate-produced capture for its declared revision; checkout stdio renders the working tree now.

name: scene_snapshot
description: Return the redacted semantic tree for a canonical scene. Hosted MCP reads a deploy-time offscreen snapshot; checkout stdio drives the current headless renderer.

name: release_info
description: Report the exact deployed or working-copy revision, release cohort, Rust compatibility, package/component/symbol/scene counts, and available MCP capabilities.

name: search_components
description: Compatibility alias for component/type search. New clients should use search_library.

name: component
description: Compatibility alias for reading one component or supporting type. New clients should use library_item.

name: scene
description: Compatibility alias returning one canonical compiling scene example. New clients should use library_item.

name: rules
description: Compatibility alias returning the repository's agent entry point and enforced development rules.
